Support

If you run into a problem or have a suggestion, please write to us by email.

Contact: ipe.haven@gmail.com

We aim to reply within a few business days.

Helpful details to include

  • Your device model and operating system version
  • The App version
  • What was happening when the problem occurred, with a screenshot if you have one

Frequently asked questions

Is Claimball out yet?

Not yet. Claimball is coming soon to iOS and Android. Store badges on this site are placeholders until then.

How much does it cost?

Claimball is free to try, and a single purchase unlocks the full game. There are no ads and no subscription. The price will be announced closer to launch.

Do you collect personal information?

The app collects no personal information and has no analytics. This website collects basic visit statistics through Google Analytics. See the Privacy Policy for details.
